system.biography:
These creatures are aggressive and territorial hunters, with arms reaching 10 feet or more in length. Their tentacles are studded with barbs and sharp-edged suckers.

Combat

An opponent can attack a giant octopus’s tentacles with a sunder attempt as if they were weapons. A giant octopus’s tentacles have 10 hit points each. If a giant octopus is currently grappling a target with the tentacle that is being attacked, it usually uses another limb to make its attack of opportunity against the opponent making the sunder attempt. Severing one of a giant octopus’s tentacles deals 5 points of damage to the creature. A giant octopus usually withdraws from combat if it loses four tentacles. The creature regrows severed limbs in 1d10+10 days.

Constrict (Ex)

A giant octopus deals 2d8+6 points of damage with a successful grapple check.

Improved Grab (Ex)

To use this ability, a giant octopus must hit an opponent of any size with a tentacle attack. It can then attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity. If it wins the grapple check, it establishes a hold and can constrict.

Ink Cloud (Ex)

A giant octopus can emit a cloud of jet-black ink 20 feet high by 20 feet wide by 20 feet long once per minute as a free action. The cloud provides total concealment, which the octopus normally uses to escape a losing fight. All vision within the cloud is obscured.

Jet (Ex)

A giant octopus can jet backward once per round as a full-round action, at a speed of 200 feet. It must move in a straight line, but does not provoke attacks of opportunity while jetting.

Skills

A giant octopus can change colors, giving it a +4 racial bonus on Hide checks. A giant octopus also can squeeze and contort its body, giving it a +10 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks. A giant octopus has a +8 racial bonus on any Swim check to perform some special action or avoid a hazard. It can always choose to take 10 on a Swim check, even if distracted or endangered. It can use the run action while swimming, provided it swims in a straight line.

system.benefit: You gain +3 hit points. For every Hit Die beyond 3, you gain an additional +1 hit point. If you have more than 3 Hit Dice, you gain +1 hit points whenever you gain a Hit Die (such as when you gain a level).

system.description: Make an Escape Artist check to slip out of bonds or escape from a grapple.
Make a Hide check to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on people without being seen or heard.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
Make a Swim check once per round while you are in the water. Success means you may swim at up to one-half your speed (as a full-round action) or at one-quarter your speed (as a move action).

What it does (SRD): In starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar dim lighting, the creature can see twice as far as a human can in the same light. It retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under those conditions that a human could not.

ThirdEra: Low-light vision is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects (no extra distance is needed for the usual reading of the rule). The character sheet includes it with other vision from items and race.

What it does (SRD): If the creature hits with a listed natural weapon, it can attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity. Details (size modifiers, opposed checks, holding vs pinning) follow the grapple rules.

ThirdEra: This template has no numeric rows in Mechanical effects or Capability grants. Track grapple state in play; use the NPC’s natural attacks and CMB/CMD from the sheet when resolving the grapple.

What it does (SRD): On a successful grapple check, the creature deals extra bludgeoning damage (the amount is given in the creature’s stat block). Constrict usually requires a successful grapple after a grab-capable attack.

ThirdEra: Leave Mechanical effects and Capability grants empty here; enter the printed constriction damage and any special rules in the NPC’s Description or natural attack notes so it matches the SRD stat block.

Tentacles (Ex): Tentacles can be sundered as weapons (10 hp each); severing one deals 5 damage to the octopus; usually withdraws after losing four tentacles; regrows in 1d10+10 days.

Ink cloud (Ex): 20-ft. cube once per minute (free action) — total concealment.

Jet (Ex): Full-round action to jet 200 ft. backward in a straight line without provoking.

Skills: +4 racial on Hide (color change), +10 on Escape Artist, +8 on Swim (special actions/hazards), always take 10 on Swim, run while swimming straight.
